item.title: En Barcelona los chavales están volviendo a jugar al fútbol en las nuevas calles peatonalizadas. Y los viejos y los comercios se están quejando
item.description: “Niño, deja ya la pelotita”. Esta frase, tan común, se ha convertido en un sufrimiento constante en Barcelona . O eso dicen los mayores del lugar: "Esto no es pacificación, es un martirio", sentencia Joan Carles, vecino de la ronda de Sant Antoni, con prioridad peatonal , en un relato que retrata el nuevo espacio como un "polideportivo improvisado" . Y es la viva colisión entre dos políticas urbanas: pacificar el espacio público y devolver la calle al juego infantil. Sin vallas ni horarios, los adolescentes lanzan balonazos "a matar" contra farolas convertidas en portería. Los impactos… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: First observation of optical Magnus effect could sharpen quantum computer control
item.description: Table tennis professionals are true masters at redirecting fast-moving projectiles. Putting a targeted spin on a serve can make the little white ball fly straight toward the edge of the table but then, at the last moment, take a sharp curve into the left corner. The physical phenomenon behind this sporting trick is known as the Magnus effect. It acts on balls of all sizes and has helped decide more than a few soccer matches. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: El set más largo de la historia del voleibol: una hora y 29 minutos de locura

La igualdad fue máxima hasta el final, ya que en voleibol es necesario ganar por una diferencia mínima de dos puntos. item.title: Champions League heartbreak: Lyon knocked out in playoffs
item.description: Defeated by Turkish side Fenerbahçe, Lyon will not be competing in Europe’s most prestigious club competition this year. Six years after their last Champions League campaign, Lyon had set their sights on returning to the competition. Instead, they will compete in the Europa League. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: L'Equipe TV

item.title: France’s Guendouzi attacked by Lyon fans at Champions League match
item.description: Players and staff clashed after Turkish football club Fenerbahce beat Olympique Lyon 2-1 to reach the Champions League. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: Is Saka getting back to his best at Arsenal?
item.description: Bukayo Saka has struggled to produce his best on a consistent basis in recent months, but could be getting back to top form this season. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: UEFA to lift FIFA boycott threat ahead of Champions League draw
item.description: European soccer body UEFA is set to formally withdraw its threat to boycott FIFA competitions after receiving assurances Gianni Infantino’s failed World Cup sell-off plan will not be revived. UEFA’s member federations are meeting Thursday in Monaco ahead of the Champions League draw, where they are expected to end the threat. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE 24

item.title: Fearnley among Britons closing in on US Open place
item.description: Heather Watson will face compatriot Harriet Dart for a place in the US Open main draw as six British players reach the final qualifying round. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Super Bowl champions Seahawks to be sold in record $9.6bn deal
item.description: NFL owners approve the $9.612bn record sale of the reigning Super Bowl champions Seattle Seahawks to a group led by billionaire Vinod Khosla. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: 'Mini-Rodri' Gonzalez shown he will be loved at Newcastle
item.description: Nico Gonzalez is given a rapturous welcome before Newcastle's Carabao Cup win against West Brom following the £52m midfielder's arrival from Manchester City. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Slovan Bratislava through in Champions League after extra-time brilliance
item.description: A brilliant flick over the keeper from Cristian Martinez in extra time is enough to get Slovan Bratislava past Celje and in to the Champions League. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Infantino set to receive World Cup win but loses Italy's support
item.description: The pressure on the embattled FIFA president remains immense but he receives a major boost from one of his most vocal opponents. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: How to follow Thursday's Champions League draw - and who is in each pot?
item.description: BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team explains when the league phase draw for the 2026-27 Champions League is, as well as looking at who is in each pot Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: AEK Athens cruise past Levski Sofia with dominant 4-0 win
item.description: AEK Athens are through to the Champions League with a comfortable 4-0 win against Levski Sofia. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Viking reach Champions League for first time with victory over Dinamo Zagreb
item.description: Viking shock Dinamo Zagreb with a 3-1 win to book their place in the Champions League. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Liverpool v Spurs & Man Utd v Brighton - full EFL Cup third-round draw
item.description: Liverpool face Tottenham in the third round of the EFL Cup, Manchester United play Brighton and Manchester City draw Norwich. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Fenerbahce back in the Champions League after 18 years
item.description: Goals from Vedat Muriqi and Archie Brown prove to be enough for Fenerbahce to get past Lyon and in to the league stage of the Champions League. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Al-Hilal closing in on Watkins - Thursday's gossip
item.description: Chelsea line up Bournemouth's Alex Scott, Sunderland make an offer for Manchester City's Jack Grealish, and Aston Villa set to miss out on AC Milan winger Rafael Leao, plus more. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Stunning comeback sees Sabah reach Champions League for the first time
item.description: Azerbaijan side Sabah fight back from 4-2 down on aggregate to beat Hapoel Be'er Sheva of Israel 6-4 on aggregate to secure their place in the main draw of the Champions League for the first time. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Bodo/Glimt thrash NEC to ease into Champions League main draw
item.description: Bodo/Glimt reach the main draw of the Champions League for a second successive season after beating Dutch side NEC Nijmegen 3-0 in the second leg of their play-off, qualifying 6-1 on aggregate. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Celtic crash out of Champions League after humiliating defeat to LASK
item.description: Despite leading 4-0 on aggregate, Celtic are humiliated by LASK as they lose the second leg of their Champions League play-off 5-1 and are knocked out 5-4 on aggregate in Austria to miss out on the main draw of the Champions League for a second successive season. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Vrancken's side come of age as Hearts bid goodnight Vienna
item.description: After some early season setbacks, "proud" Wouter Vrancken believes Hearts are getting their rewards by securing Conference League progress. Fuente: BBC Sport.
